title: Boys Hostel
content: VVCE provides separate hostel facilities for girls and boys with necessary amenities to support a comfortable residential experience.

title: Girls Hostel
content: VVCE provides separate hostel facilities for boys and girls with secure accommodation and essential amenities.

title: Hostel room sharing
content: Hostel rooms typically accomodate multiple students in a room usually around 2 to 3 students. For specific details please contact the hostel warden or the adminstration office
